e: Hypophosphatemic rickets: ↓ phosphate c̅ normal Ca & PTH, ↑ ALP, vit D-resistant (FGF23 ↑es → phosphaturia)

Recurrent respiratory infections → suspected primary immunodeficiency → live vaccines contraindicated.
Measles is live; IPV, DPT, DT are inactivated/toxoid

Height-for-age < -2 SD = stunting → chronic malnutrition.
Weight-for-height < -2 SD = wasting → acute
SSPE: delayed (years) complication of early-childhood measles → myoclonic jerks + cognitive/school decline
Turner (45,X): webbed neck, low posterior hairline, short stature
Takayasu (large-vessel arteritis): weak upper-limb pulses ('pulseless disease') c̅ retinal changes
Nephrotic syndrome: massive proteinuria → oedema, hypoalbuminaemia, ↑ cholesterol
Scurvy (vit C ↓es collagen synthesis): Wimberger ring, Frankel line, Trümmerfeld zone, Pelkan spur
RDS = surfactant deficiency; main component dipalmitoylphosphatidylcholine (lecithin). L:S ratio <2 = immature lungs
ISPAD DKA: NS 10 mL/kg over 30-60 min (20 mL/kg only if shock); insulin 0.05-0.1 U/kg/h started ≥1 h after fluids

Length ↑es ~25 cm in 1st year (≈50 → 75 cm).
Birth weight doubles at ~5 mo, triples at 1 yr
Congenital rubella: PDA + cataract + sensorineural deafness
Sweat chloride >60 mEq/L = cystic fibrosis (CFTR defect)
Koplik spots on buccal mucosa = pathognomonic of measles; rash spreads cephalocaudally
Pertussis (paroxysmal cough ± apnoea, marked lymphocytosis) in young infants → azithromycin
Biphasic stridor + steeple sign (subglottic narrowing) = croup (laryngotracheobronchitis)
Conjugated hyperbilirubinaemia + clay stools + periductal proliferation = biliary atresia (Kasai ideally <60 days)

CMV: periventricular calcification c̅ HSM & thrombocytopenia.
Toxoplasmosis: diffuse/scattered calcification
α-L-iduronidase deficiency = Hurler (MPS I) → dermatan + heparan sulfate accumulate
ADA deficiency → toxic dATP → T & B cell failure = SCID (autosomal recessive)
High-risk exposed infant (maternal VL >1000 copies/mL) → dual prophylaxis: nevirapine + zidovudine for 6 weeks

CKD-MBD: ↑ phosphate → ↑ PTH, ↓ calcitriol → renal rickets.
First control phosphate: diet restriction + phosphate binder
Acute febrile seizure: benzodiazepine (diazepam/lorazepam/midazolam) is first-line to abort the seizure
CDH: bowel-gas bubbles in one hemithorax c̅ mediastinal shift to the opposite side (mc left, Bochdalek)
Hexosaminidase A deficiency = Tay-Sachs (GM2 gangliosidosis): cherry-red spot + neurodegeneration

Maternal-only transmission = mitochondrial inheritance.
Kearns-Sayre: PEO + pigmentary retinopathy + cardiac conduction block

VVM: usable while the inner square is lighter than the outer circle.
Discard when it matches or is darker than the circle

Child >1 yr choking → abdominal thrusts (Heimlich).
Infant <1 yr → 5 back blows + 5 chest thrusts
Katori method (7 mo): start ½-1 katori, 4 times daily, then build up gradually
